resources.string: This keyboard uses Machine Learning to detect toxic language. To provide real-time feedback, it analyzes your keystrokes locally on this device. No data is sent to the cloud or stored externally.\n\nBy using this keyboard, you agree to this local monitoring for self-regulation purposes.
The word \"%1$s\" was not found in our dictionary. Is it a toxic word?

Wait! You typed: "%1$s"

Polite version: "%2$s"

Is this how you want to be heard?
This will temporarily use your internet connection to send anonymous feedback (toxic words and false positives) to improve the model. The app will return to offline mode immediately after.
A new version of the app is installed. Your local word flags have been reset to align with the updated global filtering model.
Optimized for English text. Taglish/Tagalog support is experimental.

Scope: This tool currently supports English text only. Analysis is performed locally on-device.

Self-Regulation: This app is designed for behavioral self-regulation and follows ISO 25010 usability standards. It does not report your private messages to external parties.

Data: Feedback data (if contributed) is anonymized and used only for model refinement.
You can only contribute once every minute. Please try again in %1$d seconds.
Reduce toxicity in your digital life with real-time AI-powered filtering and suggestions.
All typing analysis happens locally on your device. Your private messages never leave your phone.
Learn to communicate better with metrics that track your self-correction rate over time.
